correctness.rationale: The explicit point/edge-vertex incidence model gives original-original distance 2, original-edge distance 1 or 3 according to incidence, and edge-edge distance 2 or 4 according to a shared endpoint. At scale 1 the graph is connected triangle-free with cycle rank C(n-1,2). At scale 2 every clique lies in precisely the listed maximal structures P (all original vertices), C_i (incidence stars), D_ij (mixed triangle), or T_ijk (subdivision-edge triangle). The core Z generated by P,C_i,D_ij has a contractible link for every subdivision vertex through sequential deletion and therefore collapses homotopically to P; each of C(n,3) remaining triangle cells T attaches along its full boundary, yielding the wedge of S2. At scale 3 each original vertex is universal so the flag complex is a cone. Independently reconstructed all graph distances and exhaustive maximal cliques for n=3,4,5,6 (8,15,26,42 respectively) with no source code run. This finite check confirms the model but the symbolic covering/link proof carries every n and all homology coefficients.
